# U73: Goals opens on yours: Rhea lands on Mine with her tabs and counts, the line counts what is shown, Group is its own choice, Needs attention is a switch on any tab, and old links open what they meant

- **Belongs to:** the Watching module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `GOALS-SCOPE`, `GOALS-ATTENTION`, `GOALS-ADDRESS`
- **Budget:** at most 8 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `logged`, `one-action` ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `/goals` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U73

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Go to `/goals` in the demo.
- **Check:** The address becomes “scope=mine”.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the address matches “scope=mine” (else: Goals opened at {p.url()}).
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `JSON.stringify(tabs) === JSON.stringify(['Mine 8', 'My team 17', 'Watching 12', 'All 126'])`, where `const tabs = (await p.getByRole('tablist', { name: 'Whose goals' }).getByRole('tab').allInnerTexts()).map((t) => t.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim())`. Else it says: the tabs are {tabs.join(' | ')}.
- **Check:** “8 goals, worst first.” is shown in the Goals count line (else: the line does not count the goals shown).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “mine”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ All, as trees; then the switch on it.
- **Step.** Press the “All” tab.
- **Check:** The address becomes “scope=all”.
- **Check:** “126 goals, as trees.” is shown in the Goals count line (else: All is not counted as trees).
- **Step.** Press the “Needs attention · N” button.
- **Check:** “need attention:” is shown in the Goals count line (else: the switch does not say how many need attention).
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `/attention=1/.test(p.url()) && await sw.first().getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true'`, where `const sw = p.getByRole('button', { name: /^Needs attention · \d+$/ })`. Else it says: the switch is not in the address.
- _Note:_ Old links open what they meant.
- Go to `/goals?show=levels` in the demo.
- **Check:** The address becomes “scope=all&group=level”.
- Go to `/watching` in the demo.
- **Check:** The address becomes “scope=watching”.
- **Check:** (`parity`) the address matches “scope=watching” (else: /watching opened {p.url()}).
- **Check:** (`progress`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** (`errors`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
